searched.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0 — PET-CF
searched.notes: 5 pages. p.1 Specifications + Recommended Printing Settings; p.2 Physical and Mechanical Properties (dry state); p.3 Other Physical and Chemical Properties + Specimen Test. No filament length and no hardness are stated. Stated but with no registry key: melt index, crystallization temperature, saturated water absorption, Young's modulus, retraction, overhang, bridging, storage humidity.

searched.title: SDS20260701T01 Bambu PET CF
searched.notes: 19 pages. Section 9 gives melting point and density as 'No data available'. Section 3 gives composition PET 80-88 % / carbon fiber 12-20 % by weight (no registry key).

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters
searched.notes: Rows are for the family 'PET-CF/GF', not Bambu PET-CF alone. Its nozzle range 260 - 300 (±10 °C) and per-plate bed ranges differ from the product TDS; the TDS values are kept (higher rank, product-specific).

searched.title: PET-CF / PPA-CF / PPS-CF / PA6 CF Carbon Fibers Filament Usage Guide
searched.notes: Its mechanical/HDT figures for PET-CF repeat the TDS (131 MPa, 36.0 kJ/m², 205 °C). Source of motion.max_flow (8 mm³/s) and of the hardware-compatibility relations.

searched.title: Filament Drying
searched.notes: Appendix I PET-CF row agrees with the TDS oven setting (80 °C, 8-12 h); also heatbed 90-100 °C 12 h, AMS 2 Pro not compatible, AMS HT 80 °C 12 h.
